stops.name: Parco regionale del Delta del Po
stops.detail: The regional park of the Delta del Po of Emilia-Romagna is a protected natural area established in 1988 of about 54 000 hectares located in the Emilia-Romagna region. The park is re-built in the municipalities of Cervia, Ravenna and Alfonsine in Province of Ravenna, and in the municipalities of Argenta, Ostellato, Comacchio, Codigoro, Goro and Mesola in the province of Ferrara.
